channel.title: Engineered Systems Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Engineered Systems Magazine (esmagazine.com)

item.title: Zero Homes Raises $16.8M to Digitize Home Upgrades for Homeowners and Contractors
item.description: The startup’s end-to-end platform turns smartphone scans into ACCA-certified, DOE-validated upgrade designs, and just secured $16.8 million to grow.

item.title: Daikin Announces New Cloud Tools for Contractor Productivity and Homeowner Satisfaction
item.description: Daikin ONE Cloud Services solutions, designed to enhance HVAC contractors’ productivity, and Daikin ONE Home, designed to improve the homeowner’s indoor comfort experience, compared to the previous Daikin ONE platform, are now SkyportCare and SkyportHome.

item.title: VRF System Design Guide by Building Type
item.description: we outline key considerations for selecting and designing traditional VRF and Hybrid VRF (HVRF) systems, explain their differences and highlight best practices for enhancing performance and compliance.

item.title: What Are the Best Practices for Training Teams on AI Readiness in HVAC?
item.description: Introducing AI can cause anxiety amongst team members, but it's up to leadership to show how beneficial it can be.

item.title: Scorpion’s New Industry Report Reveals a Disconnect Between Homeowners and Local Service Businesses
item.description: The study shows that 83% of homeowners start their search online, and 22% now use AI tools such as ChatGPT to research or find recommendations.

item.title: Supreme Court Limits Trump’s Tariff Powers in 6-3 Decision
item.description: The U.S. Supreme Court ruled on Friday that President Donald Trump does not have unilateral authority to impose tariffs, though it's unclear whether this will relieve pain points the HVAC industry has faced due to rising costs.

item.title: The HVACR Guide to Google Ads in 2026
item.description: If you’re not using Local Services Ads, you may be missing the highest-intent leads in your market.

item.title: Sensirion Announces CO₂ sensor
item.description: Many sensors in use today successfully apply automatic baseline calibration algorithms (i.e., “ABC” or “ASC”) to maintain their accuracy over time.

item.title: The NEWSMakers Podcast: When Winter Hits Hard
item.description: Parts Town’s Scott Pierson breaks down what actually slows contractors down during major winter storms — and how smarter parts strategy can reduce downtime, stress, and lost revenue.

item.title: Johnson Controls Signs Agreement to Acquire Alloy Enterprises
item.description: The move will expand Johnson Controls' leadership and capabilities in the high growth data center cooling segment.
